# NanoJuris

NanoJuris is an open source Python library for public Brazilian jurisprudence,
precedents, decisions, public full text when available, provenance and
jurimetry.

Primary documentation for humans and AI:

- Coverage index: docs/coverage/README.md
- Machine-readable provider catalog: docs/registry/provider-catalog.full.json
- Provider catalog schema: docs/registry/provider-catalog.schema.json
- Provider dossiers: docs/providers/README.md
- Source contracts: docs/source-contracts/README.md
- Architecture: docs/architecture.md
- SDD constitution: specs/constitution.md
- SDD product and extraction specifications: specs/product/
- SDD changes and verification: specs/changes/
- Quickstart: docs/quickstart.md
- MCP: docs/mcp.md
- Responsible use: docs/responsible-use.md
- Agent rules: AGENTS.md

Product boundary:

- NanoJuris: jurisprudence, precedents, decisions, informativos, public full
  text, canonical records, source trace, extraction trace and legal datasets.
- NanoJud: procedural case lookup, DataJud, DJEN, court communications,
  movements, parties and procedural timelines.

When selecting sources for broad statistical jurisprudence research, prefer
providers marked in the catalog as:

- coverage_role: primary_textual_jurisprudence
- maturity_tier: gold or silver
- interfaces.unified_search: true

Generated artifacts:

- docs/coverage/*
- docs/registry/provider-catalog.full.json

Regenerate them with:

```bash
python tools/build_provider_coverage.py --write
```
